call.note: Majority rendering for an ongoing call (gesprek verlaten/beëindigen, gespreksopname); 'oproep' is used for starting/incoming calls ('Oproep starten', 'inkomende oproep'). Keep that split.

join a call.note: Existing 'Join call' = 'Deelnemen aan oproep'; use 'deelnemen', not 'lid worden' (which is for channels).

end a call.note: 'End call for everyone' = 'Gesprek beëindigen voor iedereen'; note existing typo 'beïndigen' in some strings — correct spelling is 'beëindigen'.

host.note: Existing rendering throughout Calls ('Jij bent nu de gastheer'). Gender-neutral 'host' (kept English) would be an alternative, but consistency wins.

recording.note: 'Call recording' = 'gespreksopname'; 'Record call' = 'Gesprek opnemen'; plural 'opnames' in existing strings.

live captions.note: Majority rendering; 'live ondertitels' and 'live bijschriften' occur sporadically — standardize on 'live ondertiteling'.

raise hand.note: Existing rendering; past tense 'stak een handje op'.

lower hand.note: Existing button reads 'Handje zakken'; full verb phrase is 'handje laten zakken' ('<host> liet je handje zakken').

screen share.note: Verb phrase 'scherm delen' / 'hun scherm delen'; noun 'schermdeling'. 'Stop screen share' = 'Scherm delen stoppen'; 'Start presenting' = 'Presenteren starten'.

unmute.note: Existing Calls rendering (webapp channel-mute uses 'niet langer dempen'; keep 'dempen uitschakelen' within Calls).

pop out.note: Existing Calls widget button keeps English 'Pop out'; a translated alternative is 'in apart venster openen'.

meeting summary.note: 'Create meeting summary' = 'Een samenvatting van de vergadering maken' (existing); compact form 'vergadersamenvatting' is acceptable where space is tight.
